curve.target_group: prime-order subgroup generated by official ECC2K-130 G

factor_base.construction: Take the ten-dimensional ONB subspace V generated by the ordered masks retained in this candidate record; enumerate nonzero phi in each of the 131 Frobenius conjugates F_i=Frob^i(V), lift x=phi^-1+1 to the binary curve, project by [4], and retain the exact distinct nonidentity points in the prime subgroup. The basis and full point set are digest-bound.
factor_base.folding: One representative per signed 131-step Frobenius orbit with exact subgroup eigenvalue coefficients.
factor_base.sign_frobenius_quotient_rule: Negation and all 131 Frobenius conjugates are folded using the exact prime-subgroup Frobenius eigenvalue; all orbit lifts and collisions are independently checked.

field.basis: gamma_i = zeta^i + zeta^(-i), i=1..131; squaring permutes coordinates by fold(2*i mod 263); official polynomial generator maps to the audited ONB coordinate onb_root
field.element_encoding: 131-bit integer coordinate mask; bit i is the coefficient of gamma_(i+1), little-endian
field.representation: permuted Type-II optimal normal basis; inversion-fixed symmetric vectors in the cyclic ring of length 263, modulo the all-ones vector

point_decomposition.cache_policy: Reuse the in-process curve, sparse factor base, orbit map and verified factor-base logarithms for the one public target; rebuild each target-dependent XCNF; no cached target answer.
point_decomposition.chain: Fifteen-leaf P_phi,3 decomposition, with a two-bit selector among the four audited order-four cofactor-fiber endpoints of the one supplied Q; leaf positions use F_i=Frob^i(V), i=0..14.
point_decomposition.equation_order: Exact selector and algebraic-variable insertion order emitted by the m16 formula template with frozen DIM=10 and M=15; source-bound by hashes.
point_decomposition.factor_base_membership: Exactly 532 valid phi selectors per position from the audited d10 basis; invalid selectors are forbidden in the XCNF.

formula_counts.roots_field_meaning: four cofactor endpoints times 131 coordinate bits

point_decomposition.internal_matrix_kernel: CryptoMiniSat native XOR/Gaussian elimination with at most 10000 rows, 15000 columns, 10 matrices, autodisable_gauss=true. This is internal PDP solving, not final relation-matrix LA.
point_decomposition.monomial_order: Exact selector and algebraic-variable insertion order emitted by the digest-bound gate. Leaf i uses its position-specific Frobenius domain F_i=Frobenius^i(V); the domains are disjoint away from excluded zero, and the formula imposes no separate leaf-permutation quotient.
point_decomposition.point_ordering: Position is fixed by the distinct F_i domains; no lexicographic sorting or separate summand-permutation quotient is imposed.
point_decomposition.query_limits: Per-run time and memory limits are frozen in the run protocol.
point_decomposition.sign_lifting: enumerate all signs during exact curve-point lift; reject repeated points up to sign
point_decomposition.solver_family: Boolean XCNF with CryptoMiniSat native XOR and CDCL
point_decomposition.summation_polynomial: P_phi,3 point-decomposition chain with exact binary-curve group additions between partial sums.
point_decomposition.weil_descent_encoding: Boolean ONB coordinate encoding of the P_phi,3 addition-chain equations over GF(2^131), with exact cofactor-fiber endpoint constraints.

relation_collection.duplicate_and_dependency_handling: Incremental RREF over the prime subgroup; retain only rank-increasing rows and assert dependent rows are consistent.
relation_collection.filtering: Exact base membership, subgroup-verified point lift, proper signed summands, exact target group equality.
relation_collection.precomputation_policy: Solve one generated target per query until rank 532 or the per-run attempt cap is exhausted.
relation_collection.primary_workload_policy: Exactly one supplied unseen public Q; no batch, no multi-target average, and no shared-target amortization.
relation_collection.stop_criterion: Stop target-independent collection at rank 532; record and preserve any per-run timeout, failure, OOM, or attempt-cap exit before starting the single public-Q online query.
relation_collection.target_query_distribution: Every precomputation query is one independently generated uniform nonzero scalar multiple aG; the primary online workload is the one previously unseen supplied public Q.
relation_collection.verification: Decode each model, check the exact signed curve-point lift and subgroup relation, normalize to sum(row_i*FB_i)=[4]target, and replay in the curve group.
relation_collection.walk_or_sampling_rule: Direct random-target point-decomposition query; no random walk. Precomputation targets are generated sequentially by the run's frozen PRNG.

relation_linear_algebra.orbit_quotient: Signed 131-step Frobenius orbits across 532 effective columns.
relation_linear_algebra.row_construction: Signed decomposition rows folded by exact Frobenius coefficients and normalized to positive RHS [4]target; known scalar supplies 4a mod r for target-independent precomputation.
relation_linear_algebra.solver: Incremental dense RREF over the prime field during relation collection; solve only after full rank.

target_descent.policy: Direct fifteen-summand decomposition of the one supplied Q, exact positive-RHS row normalization, dot product with independently verified factor-base logs, multiply by inverse(4) mod r, and independently replay recovered scalar against G and Q.
target_descent.success_condition: Exact scalar replay [a]G=Q in the prime subgroup.

correctness_fix.description: The v1 formula receipt's roots field counts endpoint coordinate bits; the returned roots list counts fourteen 131-bit chain equations.

unmeasured_heuristic.assumption: ordered signed sums are uniform over the full curve of order 4r; fixed official-Q count is unmeasured
